body: `p_input` does not match the java/kotlin stype, can you update the parameter name.

Should this also check for `p_input.startsWith(".")`? 
The [documentation](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/webkit/MimeTypeMap#getMimeTypeFromExtension(java.lang.String)) states that the passed parameter should be `A file extension without the leading '.'`
Seems like we should do this check at the beginning of the method.
I've observed this format being used in other Java/Kotlin files as well, and most importantly, I couldn't come up with a better name 😅.
Those are leftovers that I haven't yet got to clean :(
